name: @fuaran-ui/observer-core
description: Workspace-internal observer scaffolding shared by the layout and style observers: the node registry, isolated subscribers, flag change detection, data-fuaran-node-id self-discovery, the MutationObserver rescan, the animation-frame flush with its debounce, and the React hook body. Deliberately not published: each observer package bundles it at build time and keeps its public classes and hook as thin wrappers, so no public import path depends on this package.
